name: M&G
recent: Marine & General 在2026年10月22日举行股东大会，所有议案均获通过；期间多名董事及大股东申报在公开市场买卖股份。公司于10月14日因 JMM PS 交换而发行2500万新股上市，另于9月23日公布截至2026年7月31日季度业绩。
notable: 股东大会于2026年10月22日举行，所有议案包括重选董事及批准董事酬金均获通过。
因 JMM PS 交换而发行的2500万新股于2026年10月14日上市，发行价每股 RM0.10。
截至2026年7月31日季度净利为 RM6.518mil，营收 RM75.594mil。
risks: 非执行董事 Nik Abdul Malik bin Nik Mohd Amin 于2026年10月5日至7日期间在公开市场减持共2,339,000股。
主席兼执行董事 Tan Sri Mohammed Azlan bin Hashim 于2026年9月30日至10月2日期间在公开市场减持共8,416,500股（视为权益）。
季度营收同比下滑19.3%，净利同比下滑62.1%。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日季度营收为 RM75.594mil，环比增长13.3%，但同比下滑19.3%；净利为 RM6.518mil，净利率8.6%，净利同比下滑62.1%，上一季度净利率为 -9.2%。

recent_en: Marine & General held its general meeting on 22 October 2026 with all resolutions passed; several directors and a substantial shareholder reported open-market dealings in shares during the period. The company listed 25 million new shares on 14 October from the JMM PS exchange, and announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026 on 23 September.
notable_en: The general meeting was held on 22 October 2026 and all resolutions, including re-election of directors and approval of directors' remuneration, were passed.
25 million new shares from the JMM PS exchange were listed on 14 October 2026 at an issue price of RM0.10 per share.
Net profit for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 was RM6.518mil on revenue of RM75.594mil.
risks_en: Non-Executive Director Nik Abdul Malik bin Nik Mohd Amin disposed a total of 2,339,000 shares in the open market between 5 and 7 October 2026.
Chairman & Executive Director Tan Sri Mohammed Azlan bin Hashim disposed a total of 8,416,500 shares (deemed interest) in the open market between 30 September and 2 October 2026.
Quarterly revenue fell 19.3% year-on-year and net profit fell 62.1% year-on-year.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was RM75.594mil, up 13.3% quarter-on-quarter but down 19.3% year-on-year; net profit was RM6.518mil with an 8.6% net margin, down 62.1% year-on-year, versus a net margin of -9.2% in the prior quarter.
